kem.cpu_note: User+system CPU across the timed loop, divided by iterations. On this harness the process is pinned to one core with nothing else scheduled, so this reads close to wall time by construction. It becomes informative only when utilisation varies under contention, which this harness deliberately does not create.
kem.rss_note: Growth in the process high-water mark across the loop. ru_maxrss is a peak that never falls, so this is NOT a per-operation footprint and is not divided by the iteration count -- doing so would produce a confident, meaningless number.
kem.rss_unit_note: ru_maxrss read as kilobytes (Linux convention) and converted to bytes.
